architecture: Exact fresh original F0 initializer before deletion: existing CNN/Gate/head tensors, one 64-hidden scalar NEZ readout, original branch scaling, first-GELU physiological FiLM, late Gate, pre-reference, two-phase/seizure pooling and patient Raw96 Z. Raw-only/physiology-only slice the same full first-layer initialization; retain original scaling, not new widths or classifiers. No trained F0/C2 weights initialize new fits.
single_switches: Late gate=parameter-free ones; both guidance=remove early and late but retain direct14. FeaturePR removes only summary14 patient Z with exact noPR FIT-only bank. RawPR removes only final96 patient Z, not per-window normalization. Raw pre-reference removes only latent subtraction, not physiology DELTA definition. Head interaction removes bounded multiplicative hidden term. All other arithmetic and support unchanged.
feature_mask: Each DROP masks both corresponding post-preprocessing summary coordinates and the matching original window coordinate before BOTH earlyFiLM and lateGate. Train-time and validation/test masking identical. Width remains14 and7; never test-only deletion. Raw may still encode correlated physiology; explicit-coordinate deletion is not removal of all information about that physiological attribute.
mismatch: Only earlyFiLM receives another channel's whole conditioning trajectory from the SAME patient/seizure and identical complete window-mask group. Within each group, canonical channel ordering is cyclically shifted by a nonzero SHA256-seeded offset from seed42/fold/patient/seizure/group. Singletons unchanged and counted. All valid support, original lateGate and direct14 retained. Label-independent mapping hashes private; publish aggregate changed/eligible support only.
